messages:
ellie: Juniper found my missing sock and decided to claim my keyboard as a nest. photo: https://imgur.com/exampleJuniperSock
ben: OMG the tuck. give them a tiny crown :crown:
marisol: that is an executive decision. :joy:
alex: pet takeover ETA: 0 minutes
raj: what kind of sock was it? key question
ellie: it was a neon green tube sock i bought in college. apparently very nostalgic.
sam: can we get a #desk-pets calendar? I vote Juniper for March.
ellie: vote recorded. i’ll bribe with occasional sock depositings.
ellie: also mini poll: do we let Juniper into the meeting room? :thinking_face:
ben: yes but only if they RSVP
marisol: only with helmet
alex: helmet pic or it didn’t happen :camera_with_flash:
ellie: ok here’s a 1s clip: https://example.com/juniper-clip.mp4
photo-bot: (uploaded an image: juniper_sock_docking.jpg)
raj: the paw-on-key move is peak productivity sabotage :rofl:
sam: 10/10 would be sabotaged again
ellie: tagged @people-ops to see if we can get a 'bring-your-sock-pet' day :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
marisol: also can someone adopt the neon tube sock if i accidentally bleach it? :sweat_smile:
ben: i'll take it. i have a drawer full of questionable accessories
ellie: thanks team. Juniper says hi and demands more snacks :heart:
